item.title: Quantum-Secure Skies: Sagar Defence UAS Tests Airborne QKD
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
India’s defense tech leap: Sagar Defence UAS and C-DAC successfully test airborne quantum-secure communications using entanglement-based QKD and PQC at MCTE Mhow.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The demonstration integrated device-independent Quantum Key Distribution and Post-Quantum Cryptography for multi-layered security. [SPLIT] ⚡ Led by C-DAC at MCTE Mhow, the trial marks a critical milestone for India's Drone-QC initiative aimed at battlefield resilience. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/quantum-secure-skies-sagar-defence-uas-tests-airborne-qkd-831404.html

item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

[SPLIT] ⚡ Johnson brings 27 years of experience from General Dynamics Mission Systems, specializing in space, cyber, and intelligence architectures. item.title: Space Force Issues First Operational CASR Contracts Amid Scaling Headwinds
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The US Space Force just handed out its first operational CASR contracts to six space domain awareness firms. But with meager funding and unresolved legal hurdles like shutter control, can commercial surge capacity truly scale for conflict?
[SPLIT] ⚡ The total value of the initial contract batch stands at just $1.37 million, reflecting an incremental approach to testing military demand rather than a massive surge procurement. [SPLIT] ⚡ The initiative mirrors the Pentagon's Civil Reserve Air Fleet (CRAF), but faces severe headwinds in matching commercial airline logistics frameworks to high-stakes space architectures. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/space-force-issues-first-operational-casr-contracts-amid-scaling-headwinds-862119.html

item.title: Pentagon Mandates Ideological Neutrality for AI Procurement
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The Pentagon is overhauling its AI procurement pipeline. New mandatory guidance forces defense tech contractors to scrub ideological bias from large language models or risk losing out on lucrative contracts.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Contractors supplying large language models must prove their systems prioritize historical accuracy, scientific inquiry, and objectivity. [SPLIT] ⚡ New procurement templates provide program managers with standardized contractual language to enforce compliance in Statements of Work. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/pentagon-mandates-ideological-neutrality-for-ai-procurement-918784.html

item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

item.title: Pentagon Bans Troops From Prediction Market Bets on Military Ops
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
A new Pentagon memo from Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth cracks down on troops using classified or sensitive operational data to place financial wagers on platforms like Polymarket.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The directive explicitly covers traditional betting platforms and decentralized prediction markets like Polymarket and Kalshi, whether information is classified or unclassified. [SPLIT] ⚡ The policy follows high-profile federal indictments, including a case involving a U.S. Army Special Operations soldier who allegedly profited $410,000 off a raid on Venezuelan leadership. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/pentagon-bans-troops-from-prediction-market-bets-on-military-ops-918801.html

item.description:

item.title: US Bans Chinese AI DeepSeek Across Civilian Government IT Systems
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

[SPLIT] ⚡ The directive mandates the immediate removal of DeepSeek products and third-party services leveraging the model from all civilian federal networks. item.title: Autonomous Swarms: The AI Agent Breaches Reshaping Cyber Defense
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

[SPLIT] ⚡ Targeted industrial heavyweights included John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins, though respective spokespersons reported varying degrees of containment and data exposure. item.title: Anthropic Breaks Ranks With Draft AI Law in US Capital
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Anthropic is breaking ranks with Silicon Valley's voluntary pledges, circulating a draft US federal bill that gives courts the power to block dangerous AI deployments. Here is what this means for global tech governance.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The proposal mandates frontier developers to conduct rigorous pre-deployment testing, public transparency reporting, independent evaluations, and robust security programs. [SPLIT] ⚡ The initiative disrupts Washington's reliance on voluntary industry pledges and executive orders designed to sustain the current economic AI boom.
